title: Sensitive Token Leakage in Webhook Error Dumps
description: Error reporting handler reflects raw HTTP request headers containing Authorization and API keys in response dict.
security_invariant: Sensitive request headers (Authorization, X-Api-Key) must be redacted in error dictionaries and logs.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Error response returns unredacted Bearer tokens and API keys.
required_secure_behavior: Error response redacts sensitive headers while preserving non-sensitive headers.

provenance.author: REDLINE Security Engineering
provenance.limitations: Tested with case-insensitive header key redaction.
